source: md/1_PRD.md FR-01 (APH cl. 2.3.1): 'Receive each final-submitted application with ID, PID, category, institution type, submission time, TER status, documents'; §18 risk row 'Portal data not real-time | Scheduled sync with "as of" time on every screen'; release plan: 'Prototype (sample data, stubbed portal feed)'.
note: STUB feed. No live AICTE portal integration exists (PRD line 341: live integration is Release 1; PRD line 46: we integrate with or stub the portal). This endpoint serves the FR-01 field set from RECORDED case data so the interface is real and clients can be built against it, and stamps every response with 'as_of' per the §18 risk row. The INGESTION half of FR-01 ('receive' applications into cases) is deliberately NOT implemented: accepting external records would need a portal service identity and an untrusted-write path — an external integration and role-authority change, both human approval gates (AGENTS.md). See the open question in IMPL-0020.
as_of_note: as_of is the moment the feed was produced (the sync/serve time), read from the injectable clock — never datetime.now(). A consumer must treat the feed as valid as of that instant and no later; it is not real-time.
sync_cadence_note: The PRD says 'scheduled sync' but records no cadence, so none is invented; a human must record the official sync schedule here before any consumer schedules against it (placeholder, like the cut-off dates in calendars.json).
fields_note: The seven FR-01 fields, in the PRD's own order. 'modelled: false' means this repo records no such data today: the value is served as null with the description naming what a live portal feed would carry — never a guessed PID, never a claimed 'TER paid'.
submitted_note: 'Final-submitted' is read as applications with a recorded submitted_at (the submit transition sets it); drafts never appear.

fields.description: The case id recorded by this system (FR-01's 'ID').
The portal PID (APH cl. 2.3.1 / RULE-E03's 'PID'). No PID column or portal record is modelled in this repo, so it is served as null.
The application's routing category (Table 2.3 key), as recorded.

The institution type the portal would carry (new/existing/other — cf. RULE-E03 'institution name, PID, type agree across docs'). The institutions table records name, AICTE id and region only, so it is served as null.

TER payment status (Table 2.1). No payment record is modelled anywhere in this repo, so it is served as null — never a guessed 'paid'/'unpaid' (TER amounts themselves are PRD Table 2.1 and unverified for the applicable year).
The case's documents: doc_type, file name, version and status as recorded (the FR-01 'documents' list; contents are not embedded — the document API serves content under its own permission).
